visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women with long dark hair stand center-frame in a studio-like environment with a decorative backdrop. They wear matching, shimmering rose-gold sequined gowns featuring thigh-high slits. The woman on the left holds a transverse flute, while the woman on the right holds a dark wood violin. The background is a large banner with abstract colorful textures and large Chinese calligraphy. (2) The camera cuts to a medium close-up of the violinist. She smiles brightly at the lens while moving her bow across the strings. Her expression is cheerful and engaging. (3) A wide shot shows both musicians posing together as white graphic text overlays appear in the middle of the screen. (4) The scene cuts to a close-up of the flutist, who holds her instrument horizontally and mimics playing. She maintains eye contact with the camera. (5) A full-length shot reveals the duo performing on a small carpeted stage. The background banner is now fully visible, titled 'JC Artsnet Gallery'. (6) The camera transitions to a wider view of the room, showing a seated audience of approximately thirty people in a formal event hall. The audience members are mostly middle-aged and older adults, dressed in smart casual and formal attire. (7) Several cuts alternate between the musicians performing on stage and shots of the audience watching attentively. Some audience members are holding up smartphones to record the performance. (8) The final sequence returns to the duo against the artistic backdrop, performing synchronized movements while playing their respective instruments in a bright, well-lit indoor venue.
